snippet.title: Short Short Fictions - Official Gameplay Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Short Short Fictions, a pixel-based interactive trilogy developed by room6. Players will interface with a brand-new console NewWave, containing three connected tales named Don't Say Yes, To:North, and Immemorial. Short Short Fictions is coming soon to PC (Steam).
